best_section.where: the flat stretch of kerb opposite the sports oval, past the roundabout and pedestrian crossing near the park entrance, before the road climbs toward the far junction

summary: A flat, tree-shaded kerb stretch backing onto a sports oval, with an existing marked parking bay.
reasons: Backs onto an oval, not houses

drivers.seclusion: The kerb here fronts a sports oval and park, not a house frontage; nearest houses are across the carriageway or well back from the kerb. The closest houses sit at the western end near the roundabout, about 25-30 m off.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerbside lane with an existing marked parallel parking bay (visible as a painted car outline) and a parked car further along, so there's clearly room for a van to pull in, stop and pull out. No gate or barrier in the imagery.
drivers.traffic: Heroes Ave is a tertiary road signed 60 km/h, so it's busier than a quiet street, but the marked parking bay and kerbside lane take a parked vehicle out of the traffic lane, which keeps this at worst a 'maybe' on traffic rather than ruling it out.
drivers.convention: A formal painted parking bay and at least one car already parked along this stretch are a good sign that a van parked here won't stand out.

flags: Steep at both ends of the kerb run: grade climbs to about 15.6% near the far (eastern) end close to a busy junction, and drops steeply in the first 50 m near the roundabout — the chosen section itself is flat (~0%)
Low-lying: minimum elevation along the kerb is about 2.1 m; can't confirm from imagery whether a creek or drainage line is nearby
Tertiary road at 60 km/h just metres away: some road noise likely
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy overhangs the kerb from the park side, giving shade for most of the day over the best section.
cannot_judge: Night-time street lighting levels (OSM tags it as lit)
Whether the marked parking bay has any on-site time or resident restriction signage beyond what the sign screen found
Exact proximity to a creek or drainage line explaining the low elevation
